symptom: User reports Unauthorised after signing in to the hosted workspace.
root_cause: cxroute-onboard v13 reads ctx.userClaims.sub. The verified withSupabase context exposes the user ID as ctx.userClaims.id, so the handler returns 401 before loading memberships.
fix: Read ctx.userClaims.id. Preserve user authentication middleware, caller-scoped database queries and membership permissions.

tests.regression_before_fix: 4 failures and 1 pass; valid verified identities incorrectly receive 401.
tests.scope: Actual handler with documented verified-context and in-memory database adapters. Covers owner workspace, request identity spoofing, missing identity, nonmembership and per-user notification isolation. Does not claim an end-to-end middleware or live browser test.

remaining_gate: Live staff-to-widget reply and internal-note round trip; direct browser observation remains unavailable in the current secure session.

post_deployment_access.evidence: Account sign-in and authenticated device registration observed after cxroute-onboard v14. Device registration follows successful workspace loading in the shipped UI.
post_deployment_access.scope: Live Android account/workspace access; no direct screenshot or staff-to-widget round trip claimed.
